twelve-stone-lawrenceville.assessment: 12Stone Church in Lawrenceville, GA. Needs evaluation.

score_notes.christology: Affirms Nicene orthodoxy and full deity/humanity of Christ.
score_notes.scripture: Affirms inerrancy and authority of Scripture.
score_notes.gender: ARC churches vary on gender roles — some have husband-wife co-pastor models. Often seeker-sensitive rather than complementarian.
score_notes.soteriology: Salvation by grace through faith alone.
score_notes.cultural: Motto 'Relevant, fun, challenging and impacting for generations' + 'Everybody Can Take a Next Step' — seeker-accessible cultural posture; no DEI/CRT language observed.
score_notes.denominational: 12Stone affirms: 'We are a congregation of the Wesleyan Church, and our pastors are licensed/ordained under their spiritual authority.' Wesleyan is egalitarian-default per MOOP rubric. Red confirmed.
score_notes.preaching: Multi-site production attractional model under Kevin Myers legacy; Jason Berry current Senior Pastor since Aug 2023 (co-senior since 2021).
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No dedicated men's ministry visible on homepage; kids/students/young-adults/50+ tracks only.
score_notes.mission: Strong multisite growth strategy; 10,000+ weekly attendance.

twelve-stone-lawrenceville.pastor_credentials: Jason Berry succeeded founding pastor Kevin Myers in 2023. Multi-site Wesleyan megachurch.
